messages:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 - spike in `inference:garbled-output` on service redwood-gen. route:/v1/generate. Page oncall. :rotating_light:
alex: seeing alerts in Dashboard -> errors up + latency jitter. paging @oncall
oncall: on it, moving to incident thread. initial triage: canary error rate ~18% over 5m, many malformed outputs. samples attached.
rachel: any recent rollout that could correlate? saw a canary earlier this morning.
chris: yep, deploy-bot rolled weights bundle to canary (~10%) around 2398765000. weightset: weights/bundle-78.
maria: sample outputs show weird tokenization: stray <|unk|> tokens, sentences broken mid-word. feels like tokenizer/model mismatch, not pure weights numeric error.
alex: logs show tokenizer config loaded on canary = "tokenizer_v1.json" but the new weights were authored with tokenizer_v2. mismatch in manifest.
rachel: if tokenizer mismatch is the culprit we should stop routing to the new variant immediately. which flag controls routing?
chris: flag name is `deploy.rollout.new_weights_enabled`. current value: `true`.
oncall: recommend kill-switch flip to false now. @deploy-bot can you flip in prod?
deploy-bot: executing -> `fflip deploy.rollout.new_weights_enabled=false --env=prod` ... done :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Traffic rerouted to baseline model variants. error rate trending down: 18% -> 5% in 3m.
maria: re-sampled sessions after flip: outputs look normal for majority. still seeing around ~10 anomalous traces referencing the new weight hash.
alex: mitigation notes: (1) flip flag (done) (2) rollback canary weight tag to 77 (3) validate tokenizer pointer in artifact manifest and re-publish correct tokenizer.
chris: rollback command I ran for canary: 
```bash
deployctl rollback --service redwood-gen --to-tag weights/bundle-77 --canary
```
rachel: start rollback, SRE to run smoke tests and confirm latency/tail. @oncall please run smoke and report.
oncall: smoke started. quick prompts run -> baseline responses OK, latency stable. rolling monitor.
cust-success: FYI we already have a customer-reported ticket (FinLedger) about garbled citations in chat output. CS is preparing statement, triage suggests outputs were corrupted between ~2398765300-2398765450.
maria: root cause likely pipeline label ambiguity: release pipeline sometimes points tokenizer pointer to `latest` which got overwritten during quick reupload. model artifact expected explicit tokenizer hash.
alex: confirmed: pipeline step `artifact-sync` updated tokenizer pointer due to ambiguous tag resolution. this allowed weights_v2 to pair with tokenizer_v1.
rachel: handoff plan: I'll take lead on post-incident. oncall, please draft timeline & impact. alex/maria work on runtime fix and pipeline validation. chris push PR to add manifest check.
oncall: will prepare timeline. rough impact: ~12 customers had at least one anomalous generation in that window. notifying legal for potential compliance review.
deploy-bot: performed full rollback at 2398765400, baseline restored across prod. verified: no further garbled samples after 2398765455.
incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Assigned owners: rachel (incident lead), alex (runtime patch), maria (pipeline/QA), chris (deploy validation).
chris: opened PR to enforce tokenizer/model pairing check: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/842 — includes unit tests and CI gate.
rachel: good. Please include post-deploy smoke and a small canary with deterministic prompts in the pipeline.
maria: added pre-deploy validation plan: (1) manifest must include `tokenizer_hash` field (2) deploy tool rejects if model_hash/tokenizer_hash mismatch with known pairs.
alex: also adding runtime assertion that logs an explicit warning and rejects loads when tokenizer signature != expected for weightset.
rachel: thanks everyone. oncall, handoff to postmortem. please collect logs and customer timelines. :bow:
oncall: handoff complete. I'll drop a timeline + raw query results in the postmortem doc.
